Arsenal Women

  • Women's Super League · Arsenal 0–0 West Ham United

Arsenal and West Ham United drew 0–0, leaving Arsenal sixth on 15 points from 11 games. West Ham United moved up from tenth to ninth, on 13 points. Arsenal's last five read one win, three draws and one defeat, and they are unbeaten in one.

Liverpool beat Manchester United 4–0 at home after Leny Yoro was sent off in the 8th minute. Dominik Szoboszlai scored in the 10th minute and Florian Wirtz in the 13th, before Rio Ngumoha added a third in the 66th and Víctor Muñoz a fourth in the 82nd.

Liverpool climbed from fifth to fourth with 21 points, while Manchester United are 19th with 8.

Hull City beat Brighton & Hove Albion 2–0, with both goals from Oliver McBurnie in stoppage time, in the 90th minute plus two and plus five. Costinha had been sent off for Brighton in the 89th minute.

Hull climbed from 14th to 11th with 14 points; Brighton are second with 22.
